english_outline.section_1_main_conclusion: Reuters and Investing.com report Nebius Q2 2026 revenue beat and sharp adjusted EBITDA improvement; shares rose 16.5% premarket. Company official figures confirm revenue USD 582.3 million and adjusted EBITDA USD 236.2 million.
english_outline.section_2_core_business_change: Nebius AI revenue reached USD 575 million, 98% of group total; annualized run-rate revenue hit USD 3 billion; capacity sold out as it came online; customer prepayments exceeded 70% of Q2 deals.
english_outline.section_3_expectations: Management reaffirmed 2026 revenue guidance of USD 3-3.4 billion and adjusted EBITDA margin around 40%; capex guidance USD 20-25 billion; contracted power target raised to 5 GW by end-2026.
english_outline.section_4_market_pricing: Shares jumped 16.5% premarket to USD 225.15; Investing.com notes adjusted EPS beat; no named analyst ratings or target prices were provided in the source material.
english_outline.section_5_next_quarter_validation: Key validation points: capacity auction pricing, short-term contract pricing at USD 40-50 million per MW, and progress toward 800 MW-1 GW connected power by year-end.

reader_questions: 稿件称“调整后每股亏损0.68美元，远好于分析师预期的亏损51.46美元”，这一比较是否真实反映经营改善，还是被极端负值预期放大了？
稿件把“超过70%的第二季度交易包含客户预付款、2026年预计预付款总额超过90亿美元”当作改善现金流、降低需求不确定性的机制，来源是否支持这一因果推断？
稿件称“营收增长正在转化为正向盈利和现金生成”，但同期净亏损与资本开支规模如何，这一表述是否成立？
checks: 核查：Investing.com记录显示调整后EPS为负0.68美元，预期为负51.46美元，但该记录同时指出预期本身极度为负，比较会夸大超预期幅度，更有意义的信号是利润率改善与调整后EBITDA转正。原稿直接称“远好于”而未说明这一失真，需改写。
核查：Investing.com仅称超过70%的第二季度交易包含预付款、2026年预计预付款超过90亿美元，并未说明预付款改善现金流或降低需求不确定性。原稿的因果机制属于推断，来源不支持，应删除或降级为事实陈述。
核查：官方来源确认当季持续经营净亏损1.904亿美元；Investing.com记录当季资本开支约57亿美元、全年资本开支指引200亿至250亿美元。原稿“营收增长正在转化为正向盈利和现金生成”与净亏损事实冲突，需改为调整后口径并保留资本开支压力。
